title: My Father's War: Memories from Our Honored WWII Soldiers
original_title: My Father's War: Memories from Our Honored WWII Soldiers
overview: Heartfelt interviews conducted by a WWII veteran's son shows the real daily world of WWII through the eyes of sailors, soldiers and airmen from all the branches and both theaters. How they stayed alive? How they came home to raise us. Why we call WWII, My Fathers War.
